projection.method: WGS84 ellipsoid local tangent-plane linearization at castle latitude; no GCJ02/BD09 offset applied; 1 unit = 1 meter

orientation.official_guide_orientation: Compass north points upper-right; main entrance is southeast of castle; illustrated guide is rotated and not a scale-true georeferenced map.

geometry_sources.name: Shanghai Disney Resort official latest map located during this research
geometry_sources.license: © Disney; reference only, not bundled in geographic derivative dataset
geometry_sources.use: Visual validation of orientation and eight lands only. No coordinates traced from the copyrighted guide.

limitations: OSM is community-mapped, not an official Disney survey. Coordinate decimal precision is not positional accuracy; real offsets may be meters or tens of meters and no numerical positional accuracy has been verified.
All geographic geometry is derived from OSM WGS84. Never mix these coordinates directly with GCJ-02 or BD-09 basemaps.

Attraction nodes are mapped labels, while polygon landmarks use area centroids; neither is a verified entrance or building pivot. Navigation anchors are nearest mapped guest-like paths, not verified queue entrances.

No elevation, facade geometry, roof structures, vegetation height, track height, or exact ride movement is surveyed here. Building extrusion heights and path widths are rendering estimates unless specifically marked from OSM tags.

The park boundary includes backstage/service areas. Paths with explicit private/no access are flagged restricted. Absence of access=no is not proof of public access, and queue/service paths may be incomplete.
Seven land locality points and one derived Mickey Avenue midpoint are available. Exact official land boundary polygons are unavailable; no invented land boundaries were added.

Some OSM names are historical (e.g. Star Wars Launch Bay); landmarks normalize the 16 implemented names using the current official catalog, but every secondary business/POI has not been current-checked.
The OSM castle tag height_ft=60 appears inconsistent and is ignored; castle rendering height 60 m is marked an estimate, not source measurement.
The official guide is illustrative and rotated. It validates adjacency and general arrangement only, not distances or geodetic accuracy.

Source self-intersections, if present, are repaired with shapely.make_valid and reported in geometry_issues. Features crossing the park boundary are clipped; dimension-collapsed boundary-only touches are omitted.

relative_positions_true_north_frame.Mickey Avenue: southeast of castle on entrance axis
relative_positions_true_north_frame.Gardens of Imagination: southeast foreground between castle and entrance
relative_positions_true_north_frame.Disney Pixar Toy Story Land: west of castle, north of Tomorrowland
relative_positions_true_north_frame.Fantasyland: northwest and north of castle, surrounds rear of castle

relative_positions_true_north_frame.Adventure Isle: east of castle and south of Treasure Cove
